address: 253 Nguyen Hoang Street, Binh Hien Ward, Hai Chau District, Da Nang, 550000, Vietnam
bio: Come here for bánh canh – thick, chewy noodles made with tapioca starch and rice flour in a snakehead fish and pork broth. Choose toppings like fishcake, quail egg or crabcake. Order fried dough sticks for added crunch....
